note: Canonical enforcement-layer manifest (HYK-129). One entry per check/hook/gate/install target named in docs/enforcement-v1.md and the HYK-129/131 design report §1.2. Read by selfcheck-inventory.mjs; never hand-edit install_targets without also updating the real settings files they describe, or the checker will report DRIFT/NOT_INSTALLED against a manifest that no longer matches production.

checks.self_registration_note: This entry is this check's own manifest self-registration (HYK-129 사이클3, PM 보고서 §6) -- the selfcheck tool now audits its own SessionStart wiring the same way it audits every other check, closing (partially) the 'who checks the checker' bootstrap gap. checks.expected_bad: n/a -- this is a doer (writes a STATUS §1 row on a 'go <task_id>' prompt), not a bad/good gate; a 'go' prompt with a resolvable task_id/role/STATUS row updates exactly that one row

checks.expected_bad: a file in the changed set (mode: staged = git diff --cached; mode: ci = injected base SHA...HEAD) has an ESLint Tier0/1/2 violation or fails `prettier --check` -> non-zero exit, chained into hooks/pre-commit after gitleaks (not replacing it) so the commit is blocked; the same gate mirrored in .github/workflows/enforce.yml blocks the PR/push even if --no-verify skipped the local hook
checks.expected_good: changed set is empty, or every changed .mjs/.js/.json/.md file is clean -> exit 0; files untouched by the change are never inspected -- the intended amnesty for this repo's pre-existing baseline (HYK-148 coder-2 measurement: 41 lint errors, 78/113 unformatted files)

checks.ci_mirror_note: This manifest's judgeEntry has no install_target 'kind' for a plain CI run: step (only the single ci-enforce entry gets that special-cased checkCiCoverage treatment) -- so only this entry's git-hook chain is wiring-checked here. What IS automatically covered: quality-check.test.mjs is picked up by ci-enforce's dynamic whole-directory glob check like every other scripts/check/*.test.mjs file. The quality:check run: step's own presence/correctness in enforce.yml is confirmed only by this cycle's manual smoke test (coder-3 receipt), not by an automated selfcheck category -- an honest gap, not silently claimed as covered.
